title: CloudDust Vocabulary Schema
description: Schema for vocabulary items used to enrich CloudDust with metaphors and analogies.

category.description: High-level grouping (e.g., Action Tool, Dust Type, Experience).

concept.description: The name of the object or symbol (e.g., Vacuum Cleaner, Clean Air).

tags.description: Optional keywords related to this concept.

linkedPost.description: Optional list of blog post IDs that reference this concept.

tone.description: Optional tone of the concept (e.g., serious, playful, ironic).
